functional_execution: Pure suites, plugin integration and realtime suites executed in groups. The initial audible-modulation assertion targeted an already-finished attack stage; it was corrected to exercise active sustain/gain stages and rerun successfully on both platforms.
voice_scope: Digital and Phase, first four instrument / common ADSR controls only. Other engines, auxiliary fields, drum, play mode and full allocator remain pending.
sanitizers: ASan and UBSan passed; LeakSanitizer disabled because sandbox ptrace prevents its operation.
reference_model: GNU 13.1 BF524 with documented local D-register deferred writeback patch; not hardware validation
clock_status: Own per-voice integration assumption; inactive voices pause; FREE retains phase on reuse. Not a measured original allocator/cadence.

legacy_audio_regression.scope: Same GCC -O2 harness against 0.12/current headers: six legacy engines, 16 Phase and 16 Digital with both envelopes, three Punch and three Value FX variants; notes/bend/FILTER LFO/note-off; new Voice mode disabled. Not every project.

modulated_release_host_tail: Conservatively uses slowest possible release coefficient while original ADSR / Release modulation is active.
pulse_render: 0xffa04b88 in CALLBACK|INDIRECT L1 payload; no validated decrypted image, no Pulse port claimed.

video_reference.status: User requested ignoring submitted segmented batches and will supply definitive replacements; discarded batches excluded from indexing/comparison.

installer_validation: Isolated Wine install/hash/source/version/module/manifest/uninstall checks; main standalone GUI startup remains separate.
installer_sha256: See downloads/v0.13.0/SHA256SUMS.txt; installer embeds this report so its hash is external.
